identity:
Completing this mission will instantly build a new structure on your home island.

Craft a Miner's Cameo from simple tools and common building materials.  The Heart of the Island has already placed the recipe inside your mind.

New Structure: East Room 1.  A hollow chamber east of the island's center to serve as a multipurpose space, with tons of room to expand.

To take off any worn item, you can press <keybind:take_off>.

To continue the tutorial, please wear the spear strap.

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of mutation 'Make Thy Plagues Wonderful'
identity: With your power over plague comes the ability to alleviate sickness as well.  You may touch a target and cure minor illnesses as well as pause any infections they have in their tracks.  While this power is in effect, the target gains a bonus to their chance of recovery.

identity:
&<color_light_green> @User > skill -RECALIBRATE -help
</color> skill: RECALIBRATE
   Available if ᴴᵁᴹᴬᴺ is not attuned to their own reality.
   Blood is required for temporary reality stabilization.
   The user will return to their reality, then be extracted by AltarOS remote after the estimated time, 4 EARTH HOURS, has elapsed.
   The user will return to the home away from home.  ʸᵒᵘ ᶜᵃⁿⁿᵒᵗ ˢᵗᵃʸ
   Repeated visits will reattune the user to their own reality.  ᵖᵣₒᵐᵢˢₑ
   WARNING: Dimensional instability will make ᴴᵁᴹᴬᴺ communication impossible.
